reason: A project-scoped MCP client bridge that loads configured servers, exposes their tools to agent sessions, and hot-reloads configuration changes.

summaries.zh: 按项目读取 .dsh/mcp.json，连接配置的 MCP 服务器并将其工具动态提供给该项目的智能体会话。
summaries.en: Loads project-defined MCP servers from .dsh/mcp.json and dynamically exposes their tools to agent sessions with live configuration reload.

capabilities: Spawns configured MCP server child processes over stdio
Connects to configured streamable HTTP MCP endpoints
Registers MCP tools in project agent sessions
Hot-reloads MCP configuration and reconnects servers on demand
